question: What is the price tolerance for an invoice line where the unit price is higher than the PO?
gold: The excess on the line must be no more than the lower of 1% of the PO line value and ₹500.
answer_text:
Status: answered
Answer: The tolerance is the lower of 1% of the PO line value and ₹500 when the invoice unit price is higher than the PO unit price. [1] If the excess is above this, hold the line with exception PRICE_VAR and send it to the PO buyer to either amend the PO or request a credit note. [1][2] PRICE_VAR is owned by the PO buyer and must be resolved within 3 working days. [2] In practice, the system shows this same SOP v4.0 tolerance, and any different number should be reported to the Team Lead. [3]
Older sources (superseded): ₹1,000 (AP SOP v3.1); ₹1,000 (Part F); 2% (AP SOP v3.1); 2% (Part F)
judge_reason: States the exact tolerance: the excess must be no more than the lower of 1% of the PO line value and ₹500, with no contradictions to the gold answer.

question: Which GST return is used to decide whether input tax credit can be claimed?
gold: GSTR-2B, generated on the 14th of the following month.
answer_text:
Status: answered
Answer: GSTR-2B is the GST return used to decide whether input tax credit can be claimed. [1] Input tax credit is claimed only for invoices that appear in the client's GSTR-2B, which is generated on the 14th of the following month. [1] If an invoice is not in GSTR-2B by then, pay the base on the due date and hold the GST until it appears, and if still missing after two further GSTR-2B cycles, raise NOT_IN_2B to the vendor relationship owner. [1]
Expert tip: Do not chase QRMP suppliers in month one or two of a quarter for missing invoices.
Older sources (superseded): 20th of the following month (AP SOP v3.1 §4); 20th (Part F); hold GST portion (AP SOP v3.1 §4); GSTR-2A (AP SOP v3.1 §4)

question: An invoice is not in GSTR-2B by the 14th of the next month. What do I pay?
gold: Pay the base value on the due date and hold the GST amount until the invoice appears; escalate as NOT_IN_2B after two further cycles.
answer_text:
Status: answered
Answer: Pay only the base value on the due date and hold the GST amount until the invoice appears in GSTR-2B. [1] This is because GSTR-2B is generated on the 14th of the following month and input tax credit is claimed only for invoices that appear in the client's GSTR-2B. [1] If it is still missing after two further GSTR-2B cycles, raise NOT_IN_2B to the vendor relationship owner. [1][2] Exception: if a supplier who must issue an e-invoice sends an invoice without an IRN, return it as IRN_MISSING and do not pay the base value either. [3]

question: Does a non-PO rent invoice need any approval?

answer_text:

Decision: Yes
Answer: Yes—any non-PO rent invoice needs the budget owner's approval in the workflow. [1] In addition, the standard thresholds apply: up to ₹10 lakh none beyond a clean match, above ₹10 lakh up to ₹50 lakh AP Controller, and above ₹50 lakh Client CFO through the approval workflow. [2] The budget owner approval is required in addition to these threshold approvals for any non-PO invoice. [2]
Expert tip: Duplicate invoices must be sent to DUP_SUSPECT with a note and not overridden.

question: A goods invoice has no GRN. What should I do?
gold: Hold it as NO_GRN; the system notifies the requester, reminds after two working days and escalates to the requester's manager after five. Never post without a GRN.
answer_text:
Status: answered
Answer: Hold the invoice with exception code NO_GRN and let the system notify the requester automatically, and do not post it against the PO without a GRN. [1] The system sends a reminder after two working days and escalates to the requester's manager after five working days. [1] The Requester owns resolving NO_GRN and the target to resolve is 5 working days. [2] When a GRN is available, enter or confirm the PO number so the system pulls PO lines and open GRNs, then select the GRN lines that the invoice covers. [3] In practice, for the Pharma packaging supplier who invoices before dispatch, don't raise NO_GRN on day one, and for infra sites wait until Tuesday noon for Friday–Sunday receipts. [4]
Expert tip: Invoices received Friday to Sunday are held until Tuesday noon to allow Infra GRN batching to complete.

question: A bank change request asks me to call a mobile number to verify. What do I do?
gold: Do not call it. Call the number already in the vendor master, log the request as suspicious and tell the AP Controller.
answer_text:
Status: answered
Decision: Do not call the number provided
Answer: Do not call the mobile in the request; log it as suspicious and tell the AP Controller. [1] Verification is done by the Vendor Master team calling the number already in the vendor master, never a number from the request, and confirming the change with a named person. [2] When proceeding, look up the supplier’s number in the vendor master, call that number, ask for the authorised signatory, and confirm the old and new account numbers’ last four digits. [3] Only process bank changes when the supplier’s request is on letterhead, signed by an authorised signatory, and includes a cancelled cheque for the new account, and you must check for these. [4][5] In practice, a colleague did not call the provided mobile, used the vendor master number, uncovered a suspicious request and informed the AP Controller. [6]
Expert tip: A verification call to the supplier's phone number in the vendor master is required when a bank account change request is received.
